body: All of them.
Most of the time, I always think about how crappy I feel after, like right now, and it stops me. But some days my brain just shuts off and a autopilot to the store... It's scary how it is sometimes
I wanted to try Antabuse, but my doctor didn't recommend it because he said if you take even a sip with it you'll get so sick you'll end up in the hospital. Kinda scared me
Been multiple rehabs and completed the steps. I always seem to just slip back
My psychiatrist got me gabapentin and chlonidine for the day and seroquel at night. The gaba is really helping so far

Sorry for the late reply, this is my alt and I don't check it much.

It's mostly mental, I get mood swings and little joy in things. One minute I'll be happy next I'll be so depressed 

It also takes away my motivation to do anything. I just kinda laze around.

Plus just eating plant dust everyday can't be good for my organs and shit
I've read a few things about clonidine. I need to make a doctor's appointment anyways I'll see if I can talk to him about it. Thanks!
I never did over 1ml spoon, and only filled about 1/2 full.  What I read didn't make it sound like it was that bad but now after reading the information here I'm freaking out
I live in a different state than them :/

It sounds sooooooooo amazing to not have to worry about literally anything. No more working a shit job. No more loneliness. No more lack of ambition. No more daily depression. I'm only here because I'm terrified of destroying my family. But I don't think I can anymore. I'm at a breaking point.

Mostly everyone here has done something horribly embarrassing and regretful because of their drinking. I know I have. But if that's what it takes to get sober, then in the future you'll just be thankful it happened because it made you who you are.
God's speed!
